name: Grund and Gozwin

angles.text: As a gnome, you may understand Gozwin's worry over the lost schematics for his mecha-walker.
As a dwarf, you may recognize how quickly Grund defends his gnomish companion.
As an engineer, you know why Gozwin is anxious about the schematics and notes in his Mechanic's Log.

faq.answer: Grund is a dwarf, and Gozwin is his gnomish companion and an engineer. A snow leopard attacks as they camp in the snowy hills, leaving Gozwin wounded and their belongings scattered.
A snow leopard springs from the brush and grabs Gozwin in its jaws while Grund prepares a boar over the fire. Grund fires his shotgun over its head, frightening the beast away.
Gozwin's Mechanic's Log holds technical schematics for his mecha-walker. He fears someone may discover his engineering secrets if the log is found.
faq.q: Why is Gozwin's Mechanic's Log so important to him?

faq.answer: Gozwin escapes with deep scratches after Grund fires his shotgun and frightens the leopard away. The battered gnome is anxious about his lost log.
faq.q: How badly hurt was Gozwin in the attack?

faq.answer: Their camp is in the snowy hills to the northwest. You are asked to search there for the lost log and the prowling leopard.
faq.q: Where is Grund and Gozwin's camp located?

aliases: what happened to the boar roast
faq.answer: The leopard flees after Grund fires his shotgun. The snow leopard made a meal of the boar Grund was preparing.
faq.q: What happened to the meal Grund was preparing?

sections.body: You camp with Grund and Gozwin in the snowy hills for the evening. As Grund turns to prepare a boar over the fire, a snow leopard springs from the brush and seizes Gozwin in its jaws. Grund snatches up his shotgun and fires over the beast’s head. Startled, the leopard lets Gozwin go and flees into the cold crags.
sections.title: An Ambush by the Fire

sections.body: Gozwin escapes with deep scratches, but the attack scatters the camp. In the scramble, he loses his prized Mechanic's Log, which holds schematics for his mecha-walker. The battered gnome fears someone may find his engineering secrets. He cannot rest until you search the hills northwest of camp for the log and the prowling leopard.
sections.title: A Tinkerer's Lost Work

summary: At their camp in the northwestern hills, Grund and Gozwin face a snow leopard’s attack. Grund drives it off with his shotgun, but Gozwin loses his Mechanic's Log in the scramble.
